#### Custom Fields Tab

The Custom Fields tab has 80 user-definable fields, 20 of which are datetime effective. They can be used to accommodate company-specific meter information, such as division or field technician. All of the labels are user-defined and the data format can be converted to drop-downs with defined lists of options.

Custom field labels and drop-down options are managed from the [Custom Fields](../../Settings%20Manager/Application/Custom%20Fields.md) screen within the Settings Manager.

You will need the **FLOWCAL Options** privilege to customize data fields.
